tonight.headline: Still no kicker. Add one and you're the favourite
body: Your K slot has been empty since 04:39 UTC. Two moves today (Kamara for Bateman, 49ers D/ST for Giants) didn't fill it. ESPN projects you 109.8 to JuiceJam's 112.1, a 49% chance, and it's counting a zero at kicker.
Adding Eddy Pineiro (9.8, free agent) takes you to about 119.7. JuiceJam still start Nico Collins, whom Houston ruled out on Friday. The first card is the only thing to do today.

case.label: The Collins hole
case.body: Houston ruled Collins out Friday (NBC Sports). If JuiceJam swap in Jameson Williams (11.0), their lineup projects about 126.7. You'd be about 119.7 with a kicker, so the kicker doesn't win it alone. It does stop you giving away nine points.

case.label: Your Monday risk
case.body: Barkley plays Monday night. He practised Friday and is trending to play (NBC Sports Philadelphia). Tuten plays Sunday, so the fallback card has to be decided before Sunday 11:00.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: JuiceJam leave Collins in. Then a filled kicker slot puts you about 7.6 ahead on ESPN's live projection.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Free agent, no priority. Do it now; Pineiro kicks off Sunday 14:05 Mexico City
doFirst.title: Add Eddy Pineiro (K). Drop Colston Loveland
doFirst.subtitle: THE DROP IS LOVELAND. Not Kamara, not Vele, not Tuten. Free-agent add, so waiver priority stays at 6. If you've already added Cam Little, keep him and stop.

case.label: The slot
case.body: No kicker since 04:39 UTC. An empty mandatory slot costs more than churn does. This morning's card said the same thing; it wasn't used.

case.label: Why Pineiro now, not Little
case.body: This morning I picked Cam Little over ESPN's projection, on boards that ranked Pineiro 15th-17th. FantasyPros' Week 3 board now has Pineiro K3 and Little K10, which agrees with ESPN (9.8 to 8.6). With the consensus board and the projection on the same side, I take the projection. That's a change from the morning card, and it's a small one: kicker scoring is noisy, and filling the slot is what matters.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Loveland is 94.4% owned, so dropping him disagrees with the market, on the record. He has drawn 2 and 3 targets for 0.7 points a game (week archive). Caleb Williams didn't practise Friday, Bagent is still in concussion protocol, and Case Keenum, the third-string quarterback, is expected to start Monday (Heavy, 25 Sep). Gadsden has the tight-end slot, and Hunter Henry and T.J. Hockenson are free agents if you need depth later.

case.label: Why not the others
case.body: Kamara came in four hours ago; reversing that is churn. Vele is the Saints' every-down receiver. Tuten is Barkley's cover and the Lamar trade piece. Golden and Lloyd have played, so they're locked.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Loveland draws six or more targets Monday with Keenum, or clears five-plus targets in two games once Williams is back. The kicker half is wrong if Pineiro finishes outside the top 15 kickers while Little finishes top five.

case.label: What changed
case.body: Barkley practised Friday and is 'trending in the right direction to play' (NBC Sports Philadelphia, 25 Sep).

case.label: The timing trap
case.body: Barkley plays Monday; Tuten plays Sunday. If Barkley is still questionable going into Sunday, Tuten has already locked. Policy: a top-12 back who is only questionable starts. Only OUT or DOUBTFUL on Saturday moves him.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Barkley carries no designation, or only questionable, on Saturday. The card then never fires.

whatWentWrong.title: The kicker slot is still empty, after two more moves
whatWentWrong.lead: At 17:15-17:17 UTC Bateman went out for Kamara and the Giants D/ST for the 49ers. The morning's kicker card wasn't used, and the slot is still a zero.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Myers was the drop in last night's Bateman add. Today Bateman was dropped, not Loveland, and no kicker came in.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The first card fills the slot, and it names the drop on its own line: Loveland.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: If a kicker add is already queued somewhere I can't see, just make sure it lands before Sunday 14:05. The snapshot shows no kicker.

roster.footnote: Golden and Lloyd played Thursday; their actuals are shown. Everyone else plays Sunday, except Barkley and Loveland on Monday at 18:15. There's no kicker row because the roster has no kicker. Grades use footballdb's 2026 table (standard scoring, two games, 1st = fewest allowed), so the sample is thin. Times are Mexico City.

lineupCheck.verdict: The tool prefers Loveland over Gadsden on volume (4 to 3). Overridden on a named quarterback fact: Keenum, Chicago's third-stringer, is expected to start. The tool can't see the empty K slot, which is worth 9.8 (first card).

case.label: Re-checked this afternoon
case.body: Recomputed from the 21:53 UTC snapshot, with Pineiro at kicker. Your best lineup goes 119.7 to 123.4. Team 13's goes 123.5 to 125.2. Lamar is still in slot 20 behind Allen in slot 0, and White still starts at RB2. On season projections both best lineups also gain (you +46, them +23).

case.label: Honest risk
case.body: Raw season numbers look lopsided: Lamar 297.3, Tuten 166.9. That's why it's a longshot. It also removes Barkley's cover while Barkley has a stinger, though he practised Friday.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Team 13 start a second real back or trade a quarterback, Lamar lands on Baltimore's report, or Barkley is ruled out and Tuten has to start. Don't send it again. Only respond if they open the conversation.

trades.copyText: Hi, would you do Lamar for Bhayshul Tuten? Lamar sits behind Allen and can't score for you, and Tuten goes straight into your RB2 ahead of White. That's about +1.7 a week to your lineup. Propose it in ESPN if you're in.

worthALook.name: Adonai Mitchell
worthALook.lead: The receiver taking targets from your own starter.

case.label: The role
case.body: 12 targets in Week 2 to Wilson's 7 (week archive). TE Mason Taylor is ruled out again (NewYorkJets.com).

case.label: The injury
case.body: Limited Friday after catching his finger on a jersey Thursday (NewYorkJets.com). Not ruled out.

case.body: If he out-targets Garrett Wilson again at Detroit. Wrong if Wilson draws nine or more and Mitchell fewer than six. Free agent, but no seat until the kicker is solved.

case.body: ESPN has the 49ers 7.3 to the Jaguars' 7.1. The Jaguars get a New England offence that has given defences the 5th-most points (footballdb); Arizona sits 14th. The Giants, dropped today, are on waivers.

case.label: Why hold

case.label: What would change it

doNotChase.name: Jason Myers
doNotChase.lead: Your own dropped kicker. Don't claim him back.

case.label: The fact
case.body: He's on waivers until Saturday 01:00 Mexico City. FantasyPros have him K5, a fine kicker.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: A claim drops you from priority 6 to last for the season. Pineiro is a free agent now and ranks higher (K3) on the same board.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Pineiro gone before you act. Then take Cam Little, also free, rather than claim.

doNotChase.name: Tyler Shough
doNotChase.lead: He projects above Lawrence and he's free. The case for him is box scores.

case.label: The case for
case.body: ESPN projects him 17.7 to Lawrence's 16.4.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: This quarterback slot has already lost 42.8 points to chasing. Lawrence carries no injury tag and there's no role fact to override on.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Lawrence getting hurt. Shough is then the free-agent answer, since you carry no backup.

doNotChase.name: Tank Bigsby
doNotChase.lead: A handcuff to your own back, and Barkley is trending to play.

case.label: The fact
case.body: His rise (1 opportunity, then 16) came while Barkley played through the stinger. Barkley practised Friday; Bigsby returned Friday from an abdominal injury (NBC Sports Philadelphia). ESPN projects him 3.4.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Barkley ruled out for more than a week and Bigsby named the lead. Tuten covers first either way.

doNotChase.name: Josh Jacobs
doNotChase.lead: Carried from this morning: the best-looking name on the wire, and he isn't playing.

case.label: The fact
case.body: This morning's reporting had him still on the Commissioner's Exempt List (NFL.com, ESPN); he missed Thursday. ESPN labels him DAY_TO_DAY. I didn't re-search him this run.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: The NFL reinstates him AND Green Bay activate him. Even then, Lloyd is already yours.
